title: It got saucy!
content: I visit fairly frequently but last night it took a strange turn. The last time I was there it had been converted to a whole nightclub/strip club/rave theme but last night it was abandoned or closed down. I was chasing someone who looked very much like Carla from Scrubs (she was wearing purple stilettos and very adept at scaling a staircase!) But then I ended up using a lot of the bannisters and metal railings for some… kinky, adult fun-time. I think they were disused rollercoaster tracks that I’ve seen there before? Has anyone else done this?!
